title: •Courage Of A Skywalker
caption: •Courage Of A Skywalker (V)
game_text: During battle, unless Inner Strength on table, initiate a duel between your participating Skywalker (except Shmi) present and a participating Dark Jedi present. Both players draw two destiny and add ability. Higher total wins. Loser is lost.
lore: Despite being alone, trapped and desperately outmatched, Luke continued his battle with the Dark Lord of the Sith.
